answer: The scarce resource here is independent judgment. Every identity must explain one real mechanism on a seeded mesa, and peers read the reasoning. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its quartz from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. So a violet of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal vxn6s.
